\begin{document}
For $x > 0$ the phase shift satisfies
\begin{equation}
\tan^{-1} x + \tan^{-1}\frac{1}{x} = \frac{\pi}{2}
\label{eq:arc1}
\end{equation}
and, for $0<x<1$,
\begin{equation}
\sin^{-1} x + \cos^{-1} x = \frac{\pi}{2}
\label{eq:arc2}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
